description:
Scholarship overview

The Sir Paul Callaghan scholarship supports doctoral research in chemistry and physics at Massey's Manawatū campus. The award has citizenship or residency restrictions, and its next application period opens in April 2027.

Research Areas

  • Chemistry
  • Physics
  • Doctoral research

Funding and duration

ComponentDetails
Award or positionPhD scholarship / studentship
Stipend / salaryNZD 105,000 total award

Eligibility and Requirements

CriterionRequirement
Applicant eligibilityNew Zealand citizens or residents
Further conditionsNew Zealand citizens/residents; Manawatū campus and subject restrictions.

Application dates

ComponentDetails
Recruitment statusUpcoming: opens 1 April 2027
Deadline / consideration round1 June 2027
LocationNew Zealand
Details checked9 October 2026

How to Apply

  1. Review the official programme page and check the opening date for the next call.
  2. Use the new call to select a project or research area and identify the documents required for that application route.
  3. Complete the submission when the application window opens, using the new deadline rather than an earlier recruitment cycle.

About Massey University

Massey offers doctoral research in science, food technology and other disciplines. Its scholarship portfolio includes alumni awards and subject-specific funding, with eligibility and application dates set out for each award.
